content.short: PayFi protocol linking real-world payments and assets to DeFi, with a card, eSIM and lending.
content.description: PolyFlow builds payment finance, or PayFi, products that settle on-chain. Users can borrow against stablecoins, deposit into yield vaults and invest with no minimums, and its consumer products include a card that turns purchases into crypto rewards, a subscription eSIM and an AI video studio. It also offers Payment IDs to simplify global transfers, all tied to its PF token.
content.meta: PolyFlow links payments and real-world assets to DeFi with stablecoin loans, yield vaults, a rewards card and eSIMs.
